body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/37707

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1215

Candidate parent PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1122

Independent review parent PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1182

This consolidates the candidate's valid xgrammar admission fixes and corrects the two remaining counterexamples identified by independent review. At exact candidate commit `1b5d79c0a1c7553c3bcfac31ca07dd614897564c`, both object-level `allOf` schemas bypassed detection and admission, and xgrammar 0.2.1 accepted the invalid short document `{"v": "ab"}`. The same occurred when the object branches were reached through local `$defs` references.

The correction collects property schemas contributed at the same instance location by conjunctive object-level `allOf` and resolvable local `$ref` branches. It rejects a combined `pattern` plus `minLength`/`maxLength` before xgrammar compilation. It preserves boundaries: `anyOf` alternatives and differently named properties are not merged.

Failing-before evidence is retained in `reports/j-0e2a12d35abd/evidence/review-counterexamples-before.log`. Passing-after evidence is in `review-counterexamples-after.log`.

Reproduce:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-0e2a12d35abd/venv/bin/python reports/j-0e2a12d35abd/reproduce_review_counterexamples.py
PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-0e2a12d35abd/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/constrained/test_base_grammar_backend.py test/registered/unit/constrained/test_xgrammar_pattern_length.py
pre-commit run --files python/sglang/srt/constrained/xgrammar_backend.py test/registered/unit/constrained/test_xgrammar_pattern_length.py reports/j-0e2a12d35abd/reproduce_review_counterexamples.py
```

Results: the standalone two-case reproducer passes; 42 tests pass with 34 subtests; all applicable pre-commit checks pass.

Limitations: this is an SGLang admission guard for demonstrated xgrammar 0.2.x behavior, not a repair to xgrammar itself. Remote references are not fetched. No model weights, HTTP serving, native rebuild, or GPU execution were needed or used for this deterministic CPU-side schema admission/compiler defect.
